titulo: More than 82,000 properties without power as Storm Boelo batters UK
cuerpo: Met Office reports gusts of up to 84mph after weather warnings issued across Scotland, Northern Ireland and north of England More than 82,000 properties have been left without power as Storm Boelo continues to batter Scotland, Northern Ireland and the north of England. The adverse weather hitting northern parts of the UK on Saturday evening was the second named storm in as many days, after Storm Austen brought strong winds to south-west England on Friday.
